posts.title: Assassination 63rd Anniversary and Visiting Dallas-Fort Worth
posts.description: Above, looking toward the former Texas School Book Depository Building in Dealey Plaza. Photo by Armand Vaquer. Today marks the 63rd anniversary of the assassination of President John F. Kennedy in Dallas, Texas. I was nine years old at the time, yet I still remember that day. Anyone alive at the time will likely also remember what they were doing when the news hit. Above, yours truly at Southfork
